$comment: Every MCP server your agents get. 'default' goes to every agent; a key named after an agent (claude-code, codex, antigravity, cursor, claude-desktop) overrides it, and false leaves that agent out. Never put a secret here: write ${env:NAME} and save the value on each PC with `npx agent-cloud secret set NAME`. ${home} is the user's folder and ${memoryUrl} your memory server, so the same file works on every PC. A server whose program isn't installed on a PC is left out there, with a warning.
